cli_claims.note: recorded for comparison only; never used to decide the case outcome

rates.note: both rates use raw 0xc19 (common window) and the P4M common-window A done field; raw 0xc04 is whole-arm occupancy and is never a denominator

zero samples and small samples are legitimate and are never treated as errors
whole-arm and common-window occupancy are reported separately and never mixed

e2.marks_scope: verified cases only, stages separate; all failed records remain in report.cases
e2.global_claim_reason: per-case classifications are local; this offline analyzer never upgrades one case, or one condition, into a global statement

cost.lane_active_field: raw[0xc2c] (close-latched lane state, never capture-time busy)
cost.lane_active_note: raw[0xc2c] lane_active is only updated while the cost session is active and is frozen at the closing edge; it is a close-latched lane state, reported as information only, and a natural carry-out legitimately latches the A lane
cost.sampling_phase_note: samples are taken every 16th eligible A copy, so the sampler observes one fixed phase of the copy cadence; per-sample and grouped statistics describe only that sampled phase and are never extrapolated to the whole A population
cost.repetition_note: three runs per condition are engineering repetition: no p-value, no novelty claim and no full-method decision
cost.zero_sample_note: zero or small sample counts are legitimate and are not errors

hpm.note: HPM phase counters bracket each software phase (including MMIO) and are not exact hardware windows; they are reported separately and never mixed with the common window

input_hashes.note: hashed before and after the read/analysis phase; the report is written outside the input directory

notes: per-case classifications, per-condition counts and run-local marks only
no case, condition or repetition is upgraded to a global or hardware claim
one case never establishes an E2 positive result for the whole matrix
three repetitions per condition are engineering repetition: no p-value, no novelty claim, no full-method decision
explicit unknowns are reported where the evidence cannot establish a causal chain
failed, missing and surprising no-aggressor cases are kept and flagged, never dropped and never retried

cost-followup is an independent software collection segment: it does not complete the frozen 84-case plan, and the new Solo data is never merged with the earlier non-Solo data as one slowdown comparison
